status: separate exploratory physical-data protocol; no phase-10 three-view or moving-tissue claim

grid.coordinate_source: custom/computed_references/coordinates, nearest x plane; no IQ-driven positioning

methods.raw: complex DAS IQ with hardware TGC reversed
methods.svd_cut1: global spatial Casorati SVD, discard first singular mode on each 256-frame window
methods.highpass_100hz: third-order zero-phase Butterworth high-pass at 100 Hz on each 256-frame window

mask.policy: ground-truth geometry used only for evaluation and fixed anatomical crop, never filter fitting or threshold choice

limitations: One diverging-wave transmit, microbubble bolus, no controlled tissue motion or source-resolved blood; velocity/mvi maps are pipeline-derived, not independent truth. Fifteen adjacent windows per clip and five clips from one acquisition are correlated.
